sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Rules of the Road

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A01
First arrival wins the intersection, while a simultaneous four-way stop gives the nod to the driver on your right [A01].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A02
A steady yellow means the light is turning red, while a flashing yellow only orders slower speed and a sharper watch [A02].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F07, sec06-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A02
Flashing yellow asks for caution, while flashing red demands a full stop before proceeding through clear space [A02].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A02
Right on red follows any legal stop, while left on red works only from a one-way street onto another one-way street [A02].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F08, sec06-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A02
A steady green arrow grants the turn from the proper lane, while a flashing yellow arrow only permits a careful proceed [A02].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F12 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: FX-sec06-R06-P
A round yellow railroad sign gives advance warning of tracks; at the white crossbuck, stop behind the line or before the crossing when a train or rail vehicle approaches, and wait for a clear crossing [FX-sec06-R06-P].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F14 [FX-sec06-R06-P].
Source: [FX-sec06-R06-P -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A05
The eight-sided red stop sign orders a complete halt, while the downward red-and-white triangle only orders slowing for right-of-way traffic [A05].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F23 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: FX-sec06-R08-P
White regulatory boards state laws you must obey, while yellow diamonds warn of danger and green, brown, or blue guides inform and direct [FX-sec06-R08-P] [FX-sec06-R08-S0].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F22, sec06-F25 [FX-sec06-R08-P].
Source: [FX-sec06-R08-P -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A08
Triangles serve yield alone, diamonds mark present or possible hazards, pentagons mark schools, and round boards warn of railroads [A08].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F30 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A07
Red stops or forbids, green permits movement and guides, and yellow warns in general [A07].
Why it matters: group rules-of-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F29 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0048]
